hubTrigger.claim: Alibaba announced a new AI chip/model push and a >20GW 2032 Alibaba Cloud data-center capacity target while describing AI demand as exceptionally robust and supply-constrained.
Domestic AIDC delivery cycles are compressing from years toward months, shifting bottleneck pressure into power, cooling and park-level electricity systems.

mappingConclusion: Two direct main-board expressions have realized AIDC revenue/delivery conversion. The current hub event is primarily a magnitude/duration update, not yet company-specific fresh orders, so price absorption and expectation burden are decisive.
